fact: An April 2024 article by a senior state counsel says Mauritius has no specific deepfake law, but deepfake harms can be prosecuted under the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021 (fake profiles s.16, cyberbullying s.17, extortion s.18, failure to moderate s.23) and ICT Act s.46(1)(ga).
title: E-newsletter - Issue 132 April 2024
publisher: Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions
